title: Fluidd console: hide the internal technical lines (timelapse echo, AI status code, phone-message and update-notice commands, duplicate screen-state lines)
actions: [{"id": "tweaked-timelapse-frame", "name": "Echo of timelapse frame (hidden by Tweaked)", "value": "MACRO=TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME VARIABLE=takingframe"}, {"id": "tweaked-ai-code", "name": "Echo of AI status code (hidden by Tweaked)", "value": "VARIABLE=qdc_ai_error_code"}, {"id": "tweaked-notify-echo", "name": "Echo of phone message command (hidden by Tweaked)", "value": "RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=q2_notify"}, {"id": "tweaked-update-echo", "name": "Echo of update notice command (hidden by Tweaked; the red message stays)", "value": "RESPOND TYPE=error MSG=\"New TWEAKED version"}, {"id": "tweaked-smart-status-echo", "name": "Echo of screen state command (hidden by Tweaked)", "value": "$ SMART_STATUS"}, {"id": "tweaked-smart-status-state", "name": "Screen state repeat line (hidden by Tweaked)", "value": "SMART_STATUS state updated"}]
note: Fluidd's console shows technical lines nobody needs: the echo of a command the timelapse sends after every frame (one line per layer), and the AI service's status code (SAVE_VARIABLE ... qdc_ai_error_code, e.g. noodle=0 status=0) every time it restarts. Two more: the echo of the command that sends a phone message (RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=q2_notify ..., with the raw message text) and the echo of the update-notice's RESPOND command (the red 'New TWEAKED version ...' line itself stays). Also the two repeats of every screen on/off change ('$ SMART_STATUS ...' and '// SMART_STATUS state updated ...'): the one line 'Light sync: screen OFF, standby, AI=1, timelapse=1 -> LIGHT=OFF' (shortened by console-english) carries the same values. This adds six 'contains' filters to Fluidd's console filters (Fluidd settings > Console, stored in Moonraker's database on the printer, so every browser) which only HIDE those lines from the display; nothing is deleted from the printer's log. Your own filters stay, a filter you switch off stays off, and uninstall puts the saved list back as it was. The readable messages stay: 'Timelapse is on: layer N/total' (timelapse-progress-note) and 'PEI foreign object check: ...'. Reload an open Fluidd page once.
